JsonMapSchema

JsonSchema
and it has a public field 
name

https://github.com/apache/calcite/blob/master/core/src/test/java/org/apache/calcite/test/ModelTest.java
.

I have an application that worked in 2.6.3, fails in 2.7.0, so I suspect this is a regression.
